items.text: Omu mwaka gwa mwenda ogw'omu busingye bwa Zedekia omu kwezi kwa ikumi aha kiro kyakwo kya ikumi, Nebukadeneeza omugabe wa Babulooni akaija n'eihe rye ryona kuteera Yerusaalemu, yaagigota; baagyombekaho eby'okugirwanisizaho okugyehinguririza.
Batyo baagota orwo rurembo okuhitsya omu mwaka gwa ikumi na gumwe ogw'omu busingye bwa Zedekia.
Aha kiro kya mwenda omu kwezi kwa kana enjara yaaba nyingi munonga omuri orwo rurembo, abantu baamwo baarura eky'okurya.

Bwanyima Abakaludaaya baafumura orugo rw'orurembo. Ahonaaho omugabe Zedekia n'engabo ze zoona baacwa ekyo kiro, baaraba omu irembo eryabaire riri haihi n'omusiri gw'omugabe ahagati y'engo zaagwo zombi, baatoora ogurikuza Araba. (Obwo Abakaludaaya bagotsire orurembo embaju zoona).
Kwonka eihe ry'Abakaludaaya ryakurata omugabe, ryamuhikira omu mpita za Yeriko, engabo ze zoona zaamuhungaho, zaataataana.
Batyo baakwata ogwo mugabe, baamureetera omugabe wa Babulooni ahari Ribula, yaamucwera orubanja.
Baitira batabani ba Zedekia ogwo omu maisho ge, bwanyima nawe baamwihamu amaisho, baamukom n'emihama, baamutwara Babulooni.

Omu kwezi kwa kataano aha kiro kya mushanju ky'okwo kwezi, omu mwaka gwa ikumi na mwenda omu busingye bwa Nebukadeneeza omugabe wa Babulooni, Nebuzaradaani omukuru w'abarinzi, omushaija w'omugabe wa Babulooni, akaija Yerusaalemu.
Yaayotsya enju ya MUKAMA n'enju y'omugabe n'amaju goona ag'omuri Yerusaalemu; buri nju yoona empango yaagyotsya.
Eihe ryona ey'Abakaludaaya, abaizire n'omukiru w'abarinzi, baasheenya engo z'amabaare ezaabaire zeehinguririize Yerusaalemu.

Bwanyima abantu abaabaire batsigaire omu rurembo, n'abaabaire baimwire omugabe waabo beehongyeire omugabe wa Babulooni, n'abandi bantu b'obutoosha, abo boona Nebuzaradaani omukuru w'abarinzi yaabatawara bari enkwatwa.
Kwonka yaatsigamu abantu bamwe abarikuhereerukayo kuba abooro kuguma nibasharira emizaabibu kandi n'ab'okuhinga.

Kandi enyomyo z'emiringa ezaabaire ziri omu nju ya MUKAMA, n'ebitebe by'ebinaabiro n'ekitanka ky'emiringa ebyabaire biri omu nju ya MUKAMA, Abakaludaaya baabisheenyagura, baatwara emiringa yaabyo Babulooni.
Kandi baatwara enyungu n'ebyoma by'okuyooza eiju, na makansi, n'enyabya z'obubaane, n'ebindi bintu bye'miringa byona ebyabaire bikoresibwa omu murimo gwa hekalu,
n'eby'okuguhisa omuriro, n'enyabya. Ebintu ebyabaire bikozire omu zaabu omukuru w'abarinzi yaabitwara biri efeeza.
Enyomyo zombi ziri, n'ekitanka, n'ebitebe ebi Sulemaani yaakoreire enju ya MUKAMA, emiringa y'ebyo bintu byona ekaba erengire ekigyero.

Obwemi bw'enyomyo emwe bukaba buri mikono ikumi na munaana, kandi eriho omutwe gw'emiringa, obwemi bwagwo mikono eshatu; omutwe ogwo gwehinguririziibwe otugoye tw'emiringa otushobeekaine nk'akatimba, n'ebishushani by'ebijuma by'amakomamahanga, byona biri eby'emiringa; kandi enyomyo ya kabiri ekaba eine nk'ebyo, nabyo biriho ekatimba.
Bwanyima ogwo mukuru w'abarinzi yaakwata Seraaya omunyamurwa omukuru, na Zefania orikukurataho, n'abarinzi b'eirembo bonshatu;

kandi omu rurembo yihamu omutware owaabaire ari omukuru w'engabo, n'abashaija bataano abaabaire bari bamwe aha bashaija empikamugabe abaashangirwe omu rurembo, n'omuhandiiki w'omukuru w'eihe, owaabaire ahuruza engabo z'omuri egyo nsi, n'abashaija makumi mukaaga b'omu bantu b'obutoosha abaashangirew omu rurembo.
Atyo Nebuzaradaani ogwo, omukuru w'abarinzi, yaabakukumba, yaabatwara Ribula aha mugabe wa Babulooni.
Omugabe wa Babulooni yaabateera, yaabaitira Ribula omu nsi ya Hamasi. Okwo nikwo Abayuda baihirwe omu nsi yaabo, bakatwarwa bari enkwatwa.
Kandi abantu abaatsigaire omu nsi ya Yuda, abu Nebukadeneeza omugabe wa Babulooni yaatisigiremu, yaataho Gedalia mwene Ahikaamu, mwijukuru wa Shafani, kuba omutegyeki waabo.

Banyima abakuru b'engabo boona hamwe n'engabo zaabo, ku baahuriire ngu omugabe wa Babulooni ataireho Gedalia kuba omutegyeki, baija Mizipa, ahu yaabaire ari n'engabo zaabo; haija Ishimaeli mwene Nesania, Yohanaani mwene Yanihumeesi owa Netofa, na Yazania mutabani w'omushaija wa Maaka.
Gedalia yaabarahira n'abashaija baabo naagira ati: Mutatiina abakuru b'Abakaludaaya; mugume omuri egi nsi, mukorere omugabe wa Babulooni, nimwija kuba gye.

Kwonka omu kwezi kwa mushanju Ishimaeli mwene Nesania, mwijukuru wa Elishaama ow'omuryango gw'omugabe, yaija n'abashaija ikumi, baarwanisa Gedalia, baamwita hamwe n'Abayudaaya n'Abakaludaaya, abu yaabaire aine Mizipa.
Ahonaaho abantu boona, abakuru n'abato, na'bo bakuru b'engabo, baimuka, baahungira Misri ahabw'okutiina Abakaludaaya.

Yehoyakiini omugabe wa Yuda ku yaabaire amazire emyaka makumi ashatu na mushanju ari omu bukwatwa, omu kwezi kwa ikumi n'abiri aha kiro kya makumi abiri na mushanju ky'okwo kwezi, omu mwaka ogu Evili-merodaaki omugabe wa Babulooni yaatandikiiremu kutegyeka, yaiha Yehoyakiini omu kihome,
yaagamba gye nawe, yaamuha ekitebe ekirikukira eby'abandi bagabe abaabaire bari hamwe nawe Babulooni.
Atyo Yehoyakiini yaajuura ebijwaro bye'ekihome. Okuruga aho yaaguma naariira aha meeza y'omugabe ebiro bye byona;
kandi eby'okumutunga omugabe yaaguma naabimuha, buri izooba naamuha omugabo gwaryo, ebiro byona ebi yaamazire akihuriire.
